clauses.text: Agreement A's equipment rental term ends on 2026-09-30.
Maintenance performed in September 2026 incurs a separate USD 250 charge under Agreement A, payable even if the invoice is issued after September 30.
Effective October 1, 2026, Agreement B supersedes Agreement A for equipment rental only. Earned September maintenance charges under Agreement A remain valid and collectible.
October 2026 equipment rental is USD 1,200 under Agreement B.
